title: Winnipeg man dies in police custody
article: Winnipeg police are investigating the death of a 19-year-old man who died in custody early Sunday morning.
Wilfred Asham was arrested during an investigation into a stolen vehicle in the Weston area, police said.
Moments after placing Asham in an interview room, police realized he was not breathing and he was rushedto hospital, where he died, the force said.
But Asham's family has many questions about the death, said his stepfather, Louis Vosters.
It took police five hours to notify the family, said Vosters, andthen the family was not allowed to see the body.
Another young man, arrested at the same time as Asham, told Vosters that Asham was fine when they were first taken into custody but then they were separated.
